description: Monitor a website: HookPulse calls check.url every interval_sec (default 300) and alerts when it goes down and when it is back. Without an owner token, creation returns guest_token; keep it private. Read billing before a paid option. A charged request returns HTTP 402. We keep the schedule, detect missing runs and send configured alerts. Your agent can stop after setting up the monitor. A check-in proves the signal arrived, not that a backup can be restored. Alert timing depends on the check cycle. A single paid probe does not create continuous monitoring.

alert_to.description: Authorized e-mail destination. Without it, the verified account e-mail is used. A guest without alert_to or alert_url has no delivery channel.

alert_url.description: Public HTTPS URL that receives a POST on a miss (Slack Incoming, Discord, n8n).

check.description: url (http/https, public; required), method (GET or HEAD), expect_status (200-399 by default, a range a-b or one code), keyword (text that must be on the page), timeout_ms (1000..30000)

expect_status.description: Accepted status code or range, for example 200 or 200-399. Default: 200-399.

keyword.description: Text that the returned page must contain.

timeout_ms.description: Request timeout in milliseconds, from 1000 to 30000.

url.description: Public HTTP or HTTPS URL to check.

name.description: how you will recognise the site in an alert; default: its host

paused_until.description: maintenance window end (UTC ISO), max 30 days ahead

tags.description: Up to 8 tags to group this monitor: lower-case letters, digits, `.`, `_` and `-`, at most 32 characters each. A comma-separated string works too. We lower-case and de-duplicate, so `Prod` and `prod` are the same tag.
